issues.desc: CHK-001 and CHK-002 both lack the userSees field required by CLAUDE.md checklist format. CHK-001 should specify the exact lint output the user will see (e.g. npm run lint:tasks reports 0 errors); CHK-002 should specify the exact convergence_check output (e.g. annotation compliance: pass). Without userSees, verification is ambiguous.

Both CHK-001 and CHK-002 are missing the userSees field. CLAUDE.md requires userSees with precise expected output text (e.g. CHK-001: npm run lint:tasks shows 0 errors; CHK-002: koala convergence_check shows code annotation compliance: true). Without userSees, verification in TEST phase lacks a concrete observable target.

riskSignal compliance was auto-detected from annotation format compliance context, not legal/regulatory compliance. This will route the story through normal channel with full PLAN + decision_set (≥3 preMortem). The overhead is disproportionate for a comment-only chore, but the framework handles this correctly — advisory only.
